en.title: Logic of the Tide
en.premise: Nagi was once hailed as a genius, until despair drove him to flee the world of competition. Dragged back into the fold by a Tactics Club on the brink of collapse, he sets his sights on the national tournament alongside a group of awkward comrades. In a high-stakes psychological battle where a single move can alter destiny, Nagi pursues the truth that lies beyond 'victory'.

zh.title: 潮騒的逻辑
zh.premise: 曾被誉为天才，却在绝望中逃离胜负世界的少年——凪。在被拉回濒临废部的“战术部”后，他与一群不器用的伙伴们共同以全国大会为目标。在一次抉择便能决定命运的极限心理战中，他将追寻隐藏在“胜利”之彼端的真理。
